final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM invoice_averages) SELECT AVG(i.avg_product_cost), AVG(i.avg_ratio), AVG(i.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio) FROM invoice_averages AS i JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.overall_ratio IS NOT NULL AND i.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio
